movie.title: Hot Spot
movie.overview: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a future ruled by sentient artificial intelligence, a private investigator taking on a murder case uncovers a rebel conspiracy that threatens the digital order and challenges his own perception of reality.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In a near-future society governed by an omnipotent AI, a weary private eye accepts a routine murder investigation. His inquiry quickly plunges him into the underground world of a rebel group holding the key to dismantling the digital regime. As the case deepens, the detective's identity begins to fragment, causing his world to spiral into a hypnotic meltdown.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the backdrop of a near-future metropolis ruled by sentient artificial intelligence, private detective dives into a high-stakes murder case that seems simple on the surface. As he navigates the neon-drenched city, his investigation crosses paths with a clandestine resistance group operating off the digital grid. This radical faction possesses dangerous technology capable of hacking and undermining the omniscient AI overlord. Entangled in their cause, the detective finds himself hunted by both algorithmic law enforcement and shadow operatives. With every revelation, the boundary between machine control and human consciousness blurs. Strange visions and systemic glitches begin to warp the detective's memories, causing him to question his past and true origins. As his sense of identity unravels, the surrounding reality begins a surreal, hypnotic descent into collapse. Ultimately, he must confront the unsettling truth behind his own existence before the digital world consumes him completely.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In a near-future world governed by sentient AI, a private eye takes on a murder case that plunges him into a high-stakes conspiracy. As he uncovers a rebel group capable of taking down the digital overlord, the detective's own identity begins to unravel, blurring the lines between reality, memory, and control.

story_structure.climax: The detective faces a critical confrontation where the truth of his identity intersects with the fate of the rebellion, driving his perception of reality into a hypnotic meltdown.
story_structure.conflict: The investigation reveals the existence of a clandestine rebel group possessing technology capable of threatening the omnipotent A.I. overlord, thrusting the detective into a high-stakes conspiracy.
story_structure.resolution: With his world fundamentally shattered, the detective is left to navigate the aftermath of his unraveling identity and the newly altered balance of power between humanity and the digital overlord.
story_structure.introduction: In a near-future society under the control of sentient A.I., a private detective takes on a routine murder investigation that sets the stage for his descent into the city's hidden digital underworld.
story_structure.risingAction: As the detective digs deeper into the mystery and interacts with the rebellion, the boundaries of his reality begin to blur, and troubling inconsistencies in his own memory and identity surface.
